verdict.rationale: An operating system could plausibly ship an official MCP server for agents to connect to, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or any agent-facing server endpoint. Shortcuts automation and Siri AI are adjacent first-party features, not an MCP server, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
